import torch
E=W('model.embed_tokens.weight'); U=W('lm_head.weight'); g=W('model.norm.weight'); Ug=U*g
M=[' January',' February',' March',' April',' May',' June',' July',' August',' September',' October',' November',' December']
D=[' Monday',' Tuesday',' Wednesday',' Thursday',' Friday',' Saturday',' Sunday']
Nw=[' one',' two',' three',' four',' five',' six',' seven',' eight',' nine',' ten']
def ids(ws): return [encode(w)[0] for w in ws]
res=[]
for name,ws in [('month',M),('day',D),('num',Nw)]:
    I=ids(ws); n=len(I)
    X=E[I]; Y=Ug[I]
    for L in range(28):
        ln=W(f'model.layers.{L}.input_layernorm.weight')
        Xn=X/ X.pow(2).mean(1,keepdim=True).sqrt()*ln
        V=W(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.v_proj.weight') # 512x3584
        O=W(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.o_proj.weight') # 3584x3584
        for h in range(28):
            kv=h//7
            v=Xn@V[kv*128:(kv+1)*128].T
            o=v@O[:,h*128:(h+1)*128].T
            S=o@Y.T  # n x n
            S=S-S.mean(1,keepdim=True)
            succ=torch.tensor([S[i,(i+1)%n] for i in range(n)]).mean()
            diag=torch.diagonal(S).mean()
            acc=(S.argmax(1)==(torch.arange(n)+1)%n).float().mean()
            res.append((name,L,h,float(succ),float(diag),float(acc)))
for name in ['month','day','num']:

    print(name,'SUCC',[(x[1],x[2],round(x[3],2),round(x[5],2)) for x in sorted(r,key=lambda x:-x[5]*10-x[3])[:6]])
